challenge: Apps that depend on the network lose user data and break on weak connections, a real risk for flows like cross-border money transfers. I built an open reference implementation of the pattern I use to solve it.
solution: A local SQLite database (Drift) is the single source of truth, and the UI reads reactive streams, so it updates itself after every write. Changes are pushed and pulled in the background (WorkManager on Android) using client-generated UUIDs, soft deletes and a last-write-wins rule, so retries never create duplicates. The sync status (Synced, Syncing, N changes waiting, Offline) is always visible to the user.
techOrPlatform: Flutter / Dart, Drift (SQLite), Cubit, Dio, WorkManager, Express + MongoDB API

challenge: Slow initial screen loads and excessive API usage caused by fetching fresh remote data on every screen navigation.
solution: Implemented robust HTTP caching protocols using conditional headers (ETags / Cache-Control) and local cache fallbacks, drastically speeding up data load times and minimizing redundant network payloads.

challenge: High latency and increased bandwidth costs caused by delivering unoptimized static assets and heavy media files directly from origin servers.
solution: Configured a global Content Delivery Network (CDN) edge-caching layer with automated dynamic image compression and asset minification, significantly accelerating global delivery times and reducing origin server load.
techOrPlatform: CDN (Cloudflare / CloudFront, WebP Optimization, Edge Caching)
